properties.name: BR22
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Demolition of existing shops, flats and garages and redevelopment of site with housing retail and community facilities comprising: 15 x two-bed houses, 24 flats (22 x two-bed and 2 x one-bed flats), supermarket (Class A1) and takeaway (Class A5) on ground floor of flat block; associated landscaping, parking and new play area. Provision of new pedestrian crossing and visitor parking on John Barker Place.
